articleTitle: Why Your Old Deodorant Stopped Working in Menopause
imageHeadline: Your Deodorant Stopped Working. Here's Why.
imageSubtext: Menopause changes your sweat chemistry—and what you need to manage it.
pinTitle: Why Deodorant Stops Working in Menopause (And What Actually Helps)
pinDescription: Hormonal shifts during menopause change both your sweat volume and chemistry. Learn the science behind why your go-to products may not cut it anymore, plus the difference between deodorant and antiperspirant and what actually works for this stage.
